message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V3.0.3 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**AutoCaptions on one page**, captions you can **retype in the Editor**, a **tone pad** in Audio Studio, and timeline fixes.

*(Install over your current version and restart Premiere Pro once.)*

♦️ **New: AutoCaptions on one page**
* **Source**: Selected clip or Whole timeline. **Engine**: Cloud or Local. **Look**: the 20 Hook & Captions designs or plain Subtitles, with Size and Position.
* **Generate Captions** places one template per caption: every word, font and colour stays editable in Essential Graphics.
* No file field, no Browse, no full-frame text, no glow pack.

♦️ **New: edit captions in the Editor**
* Select the captions on the timeline, open **EDITOR**, type. The words go into the templates by themselves.

♦️ **New: tone pad** (Audio Studio › Presets)
* Drag one dot from dark to bright and from close to spacious. Save your own presets.

♦️ **Fixed**
* **NEST SEP** nests every selected clip again.
* **UN-NEST** when it needs a new track; new tracks go on top.
* **L-CUT / J-CUT** after another split edit ("speed is changed").
* FX & ADV RIGS "engine did not load" after an update.

♦️ **Also**: Assets side list folds on a second click, a Flex Downloader card in the Downloader, a context ring for Flex AI in the AI tab.
